name: Priya Nair
bio: Priya is the Lead Early Years Educator at Kaylan Preschool with over 12 years of experience in Montessori-based curriculum design. She loves writing about play-based learning and early childhood development.

name: Arjun Mehta
bio: Arjun is the Academic Director at Kaylan Preschool, overseeing curriculum quality across all campuses. He is passionate about evidence-based early education frameworks like Kreedo.

name: Ritu Sharma
bio: Ritu is a child psychologist and parent-engagement consultant who partners with Kaylan Preschool to help families navigate the preschool years with confidence.
